privileged_info_for_vlm: The target plan is named 'Standard Dietary Plan' and the meal is 'Morning Breakfast'. The final state must have exactly three ingredients: Rolled Oats (50g), Soy Milk (200g), and Firm Tofu (100g). Whole Milk and Chicken Egg must be deleted. The login is admin/adminadmin.
